# Tasks: <feature or product slice>

<!-- generated by scripts/render_tasks_view.py -->

Optional non-canonical human view of the run, normally written to `docs/goal/tasks.md` (see the Project Size Gate in `SKILL.md` and the File Size Limit in the project `AGENTS.md`). Render it from the canonical pair instead of hand-writing it:

```text
python <skill>/scripts/render_tasks_view.py --plan docs/goal/PLAN.md --run docs/goal/RUN.md --out docs/goal/tasks.md
```

The view groups one section per mission — objective, phase, mission dependencies, blockers — under a progress header (missions integrated, tasks recorded, current frontier), with each mission's tasks listed as `task | objective | depends on | phase | verifier | attempts | commit`.

Regenerate it from `RUN.md`'s canonical `mission_states`, `task_states`, and `graph_state` whenever that state changes — never a second source of truth. A managed-sequential run may omit it. The renderer refuses a PLAN/RUN pair that no longer validates and refuses to overwrite a file it did not generate. If this file and `RUN.md` ever disagree, `RUN.md` is right; regenerate this file from it, and never re-derive a phase, transition, or unblock rule here — cite `references/execution-state-model.md`'s "Canonical Mission Phases" and "Canonical Task Phases" instead of restating them, so this view can't silently drift out of sync with the rule it's displaying.
